timing: Frozen before new scenario-record implementation or authored-test inspection. This contract is additive receiving; it does not redefine the unchanged Freight rule model.

file.encoding: UTF-8; byte limit includes optional BOM and JSON whitespace
file.mime: file extension or MIME is not identity or authority
file.duplicates: No bespoke duplicate-key parser or duplicate-key guarantee is introduced; ordinary JSON parsing semantics.
file.invalidUtf8: Browser decoder behavior is not changed; admitted document values must still meet the exact envelope.

admission: Root must be a non-null non-array object with exactly schema, synthetic, exported_at, loaded_preset, provenance, contract, baseline, current, comparison.
schema is exactly workflow-checks.freight-whatif.v1 and synthetic is exactly boolean true.
exported_at is canonical UTC ISO text generated by Date.toISOString (four-digit years 0000 through 9999); it is observation metadata. No age or future-time business cutoff.
provenance and contract must recursively equal the pinned data values with exact keysets and types. They identify synthetic rule context, not proof of server freshness or authority.

loaded_preset has exactly id and title and matches one current canonical preset. baseline has exactly scenario and result; scenario must equal that canonical preset and result must equal evaluation of it.

current has exactly scenario and result. The scenario has all and only the sixteen FIELDS and is accepted by unchanged validateScenario. Preserve null versus zero, exact booleans, whole integer cents and civil-minute strings.

Every parsed number anywhere must be finite before any JSON-like comparison. Objects compare keysets and values independent of object-key order; arrays compare length, order and content. JSON numeric -0 and 0 are equivalent.

Recompute both results and comparison with unchanged evaluate/compareResults, then refuse if any stored result, flag, evidence, total or comparison differs. Unknown fields in these structures also refuse. Supplied results are never calculation or approval authority.

Valid model scenarios representing late arrival, absent tracking/POD, reversed/overlong tracking pairs, incomplete rate confirmation, or invoice disagreement remain admissible; their exception output must be recomputed exactly.
Whole-file refusal: do not salvage a current scenario from a wrong/stale envelope, inconsistent baseline, bad source pin or malformed derived claim.

state.expect: Opening and previewing a valid record changes only import preview/status. All existing raw sixteen-field values, selected baseline, results and download eligibility remain unchanged until deliberate Replace.

Replace commits all sixteen admitted values and the canonical selected preset/baseline as one action, recomputes results, and retires the preview. Existing Download produces coherent v1 from that new scenario. Existing Reset restores that canonical preset.

Cancel/close a preview or native file selection leaves the prior draft/baseline/results intact, including incomplete invalid raw draft strings. Cancellation prevents pending reads from reviving a preview.
Malformed, incompatible, unknown-key, nonfinite, oversized or mismatched-derived files show an explicit refusal, with no partial form/baseline/result replacement.

Capture current draft/baseline intent before invoking the file chooser. A draft edit, preset switch or reset during the chooser invalidates that selection, including actual raw value changes without an input event.
A draft edit/preset/reset during asynchronous read invalidates pending import. Actual raw values/state are compared again before preview and replacement.
Typing or changing baseline after preview, including direct value change before Apply without input event, prevents stale replacement. A newer review/import intent retires earlier preview.
When two reads finish out of order, only the latest still-current selection may produce a preview or error. Superseded success/error cannot replace or clear newer valid preview.
Filename '<b> invoice & café .json' and any offending value shown in refusal remain literal text; no markup, source link, script or remote fetch is generated from file content.
Import adds no automatic storage, network, downloads, approval or payment action.

steps: Use actual unchanged Download on a valid nondefault scenario
Read all sixteen preview values and source/baseline identity
Edit fuel again and download a new record
Reopen the new record and prove it binds the latest values
browser.expected: Supplied stored results remain validated evidence only; fresh UI output and exported fields match unchanged model.
Both actions preserve the invalid raw draft and paused/disabled result state until deliberate valid replacement.

steps: Exercise chooser, read and preview staleness
browser.expected: Frozen state rules above. Use controlled File.text resolution only for async delivery, not product admission/oracle replacement.

steps: Check preview fields, clear irreversible-action wording and focus path
browser.expected: Readable all-field preview and explicit replacement controls; no hidden horizontal requirement at narrow viewport. No aesthetic claim beyond inspected captures.

steps: Use existing sandboxed browser with own profile and loopback server
Observe errors and unexpected external requests
browser.expected: Native result binds exact current source. Hosted source integration and actual Pages receiving are separate gates.

nonGoals: No shared export format or utility scenario changes
No new browser storage or network service
No full original parity test rerun
fixtureProvenance: Accepted coherent record bodies are generated once by the unchanged pinned model. They are compatibility controls, not independently authored mathematical oracles. Admission/refusal mutations and state expectations are independently authored before the new importer; three stated monetary checks are hand-derived.
adapterBoundary: No production importer API is invented. A later thin adapter may map the author's public API into the frozen expected record shape without changing fixture bodies or acceptance expectations; adapter versions and execution are recorded separately.
